summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, reporting unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results. The filing details operational and financial metrics, including revenue of US$31.9 million, bitcoin production of 243 BTC, and a record cryptocurrency treasury of 1,915 BTC and 3,952 ETH. It also discloses share repurchases of approximately 16.4 million ADSs for US$7.4 million. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review is announced. This is a routine earnings release, not a corporate event requiring special-situation classification. What to watch: quarterly operational trends and ongoing capital allocation.
